lines.en: label osakospring9:
scene clearnightsky
While her heart had started in the right place, Osako Osaka now found it sinking deeper down her chest and ultimately landing somewhere near the pit of her stomach.
lines.zh: 虽然她的心一开始还待在正确的位置,Osako Osaka 如今却眼睁睁看着它沿胸腔一路下沉,最终落在离胃底不远的地方。

lines.en: Now, I’m no doctor, but I’m pretty sure something like that could kill a person. And if Osako Osaka was a normal girl (which she often thinks she is), I’m sure it already would have.
lines.zh: 喂,我不是医生,但我相当确定,这种事是能杀死一个人的。而如果 Osako Osaka 是个普通女孩(她时常这么认为),我敢说它早就得手了。

lines.en: But it’s at this point that I feel the need to bring up French entertainer, Michel Lotito, who once ate an entire Cessna 150 airplane over the course of two years as it loosely relates to what I just said.
lines.zh: 但正是在此处,我觉得有必要提一嘴法国艺人 Michel Lotito——他曾用两年时间吃掉了一整架 Cessna 150 飞机,因为我刚才说的话和这多少有点关系。

lines.en: If you were to eat a plane, you would probably die. If your heart sunk into your stomach, you would probably die.
lines.zh: 如果你去吃一架飞机,你多半会死。如果你的心脏沉进胃里,你多半会死。

lines.en: There are many things you can do that would end up with you probably dying, so chances are you don’t think of actually doing them at all.
lines.zh: 世上有很多做了多半会死的事,所以你多半压根不会想去真的做它们。

lines.en: Michel Lotito was different, though. And with the help of Pica and an odd physical capability of digesting metal, that fucker ate a goddamn plane. That’s fucking crazy.
lines.zh: 不过 Michel Lotito 不一样。在异食症和一种奇异的、能消化金属的身体机能的帮助下,那家伙真把一架飞机给吃了。这他妈太疯了。

lines.en: So to cap off that loose relation and tie Monsieur Mangetout back to Osako Osaka, I will now reveal to you the secrets of eating an aircraft assuming you meet all other prerequisites.
lines.zh: 那么,为了给这段牵强的关联收个尾、把 Monsieur Mangetout 和 Osako Osaka 绑回一起,我现在就向你揭示吃掉一架飞机的秘诀——前提是你满足其余所有先决条件。

lines.en: Go slowly. Take your time.
lines.zh: 慢慢来。别着急。

lines.en: Don’t listen to the crowd — all those people telling you that only a fool would eat an airplane.
lines.zh: 别听人群的——那些告诉你说只有傻子才会去吃飞机的人。

lines.en: Open that mouth, grab some mineral oil, and just fucking do it. Show them you can not because you can but because you want to.
lines.zh: 张开嘴,抓起矿物油,然后他妈的放手去做。让他们看看你做得到——不是因为你能,而是因为你想。

lines.en: And when the doctor lays you down on the surgical table to either put your heart back in the right place or open your black box, look him in the eyes and tell him this.
lines.zh: 而当医生把你放到手术台上,准备要么把你的心脏放回原位、要么打开你的黑匣子时,看着他的眼睛,告诉他这句话。

lines.en: It’s okay if I am different. Because yes, I ate an airplane. But how many other humans do you know with wings?
lines.zh: 我和别人不一样,没关系。因为是的,我吃掉了一架飞机。可你知道的、长着翅膀的人类,又有几个呢?

lines.en: Now, he’ll do one of two things after that. He’ll either smile and let your weird anatomical structure figure itself out in what could only be called forced malpractice, or he’ll cut you open anyway and force you to be “normal” again.
lines.zh: 而那之后,他只有两种可能。要么微笑着放任你那怪异的解剖结构自谋出路,以一种只能称之为强制医疗事故的方式;要么照样把你剖开,强迫你重新变回「正常」。

lines.en: And this is where the French and Japanese part ways. Because Lotito would have said the thing. And Osako would have chickened out and just gotten the surgery.
lines.zh: 而这,就是法国人和日本人分道扬镳之处。因为 Lotito 会把那句话说出口。而 Osako 会临阵退缩,乖乖去做手术。

lines.en: But there’s a part of her that wonders something. Something that many others in her position often do.
lines.zh: 但她有一部分,仍在好奇一件事。许多身处她这个位置的人,也常常会好奇的那件事。

lines.en: She wonders how far those wings would take her if she didn’t have them burned off.
lines.zh: 她好奇,如果没有被烧掉,那双翅膀本可以带她飞多远。

lines.en: Fly responsibly, kids. And don’t let the musings of a madman dictate anything about who you are, what your role is, or how you’re meant to cope with losing things you’ve never had.
lines.zh: 负责任地飞翔,孩子们。还有,别让一个疯子的胡思乱想,对「你是谁」「你的角色是什么」「你该如何应对失去从未拥有过的东西」这类问题指手画脚。

lines.en: Somewhere, a door is opened.
lines.zh: 在某处,一扇门被打开。

lines.en: scene osakopica1
That somewhere is here — a nondescript apartment in a small complex of identical floorplans, each with their own unique take on what it means to live.
lines.zh: 那个某处就在这里——一栋千篇一律户型的小公寓楼里一间毫不起眼的屋子,每一间都对「活着意味着什么」有着自己独特的诠释。

lines.en: The take here was that of cool dark tones, sage, and the hum of an air purifier that hadn’t been switched off or maintained in several years.
lines.zh: 这里的诠释是:冷而暗的色调、鼠尾草绿,还有一台多年没关过、也没保养过的空气净化器的嗡鸣。

lines.en: It probably didn’t even do anything anymore, but it still pretended to and it still existed. And I often feel the same way.
lines.zh: 它多半早就什么用都没有了,但它还在装作有用,还继续存在着。而我也常有同感。

lines.en: Maybe I should eat an airplane too?
lines.zh: 也许我也该去吃架飞机?

lines.en: : Hey, sorry I’m late. I stopped by the supermarket on the way back to grab your prescriptions.
lines.zh: : 嘿,抱歉我来晚了。回来路上绕了趟超市,取你的处方药。

lines.en: scene osakopica2
: I got some stuff for dinner too if-
lines.zh: : 还顺手买了点做晚饭的材料,要是——

lines.en: scene osakopica3
: Huh?
scene black
scene osakopica4
: Welcome home, my kitten. As you can see, dinner’s already taken care of.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家,我的小猫。如你所见,晚饭已经搞定了。

lines.en: : What...is this? And what...are you wearing?
lines.zh: : 这是……什么?还有你穿的……是什么?

lines.en: : Do you like it? I was planning on letting you take it off of me later.
lines.zh: : 喜欢吗?我本来打算晚点让你亲手把它脱下来。

lines.en: : It’s...beautiful. You’re beautiful. But what’s...why? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 很……漂亮。你很漂亮。可是这是……为什么?到底怎么回事?

lines.en: : What’s going on is our anniversary, of course. Which, based on this reaction, you appear to have forgotten about.
lines.zh: : 当然是我们的纪念日。而看你这反应,你似乎是把它给忘了。

lines.en: scene osakopica5
: Our...oh my God! Wakana, I’m so sorry! I‘ve just been so distracted lately and-
lines.zh: : 我们的……我的天!Wakana,对不起!我最近实在太心不在焉了,而且——

lines.en: : Shh...you have nothing to apologize for...
lines.zh: : 嘘……你没有什么可道歉的……

lines.en: scene osakopica6
: What do you mean I have nothing to apologize for? I didn’t even get you anything and you did all of this. That’s so-
lines.zh: : 什么叫没有什么可道歉的?我什么都没给你准备,你却做了这一切。这实在——

lines.en: scene osakopica7
: Wait, how did you do all of this? You can’t cook.
lines.zh: : 等等,这一切你是怎么做到的?你根本不会做饭。

lines.en: : It’s the funniest thing, actually. You remember that ancient grimoire I purchased from a flea market in college?
lines.zh: : 其实这事特别好笑。你还记得我大学时从跳蚤市场买的那本古老魔导书吗?

lines.en: : The one with pentagrams all over it that I told you to never open because it’s definitely cursed?
lines.zh: : 就是那本画满五芒星、我还叮嘱过你永远别打开、因为它绝对被诅咒了的书?

lines.en: : Turns out that opening it granted me everything I could ever want. All I needed to do was trade away a part of my soul.
lines.zh: : 结果打开它就赐予了我想要的一切。我只需要付出灵魂的一部分作为交换。

lines.en: : You can take solace in knowing I didn’t give up all of it, though. How could I when I’ve already given everything else to you?
lines.zh: : 不过你可以稍感安慰——我没有把全部灵魂都交出去。毕竟其余的一切都已经是你的了,怎么可能呢?

lines.en: : I hope it taught you necromancy too since you are so cute that I think I might actually have a heart attack.
lines.zh: : 我希望它还教了你死灵法术,因为你太可爱了,我觉得我真的可能要心脏病发作了。

lines.en: : I feel the same way. So much so that I’d let you undress me right now if there wasn’t a crown roast waiting for us.
lines.zh: : 我也深有同感。要不是还有一份皇冠烤肉等着我们,我现在就让你把我脱了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I will eat the cursed demon meat for you even if it comes at the cost of my humanity.
lines.zh: : 没关系。为了你,就算要赔上我的人性,我也会吃下这被诅咒的恶魔之肉。

lines.en: : Good girl...Though, the unfortunate truth is that this “demon meat” is really just the fruit of a favor I called in.
lines.zh: : 乖女孩……不过,不幸的真相是,这块「恶魔之肉」其实只是我动用一次人情换来的成果。

lines.en: scene osakopica8
: A...favor?
lines.zh: : 一……人情?

lines.en: : Wakana, did you actually ask your parents for-
lines.zh: : Wakana,你该不会真找你父母要了——

lines.en: : I would sooner actually sell my soul. I just looked up a certain alumni with relations to one of Akira’s students.
lines.zh: : 我宁可真去把灵魂卖了。我只是查了一位和 Akira 的某个学生有交情的校友。

lines.en: scene osakopica9
: Which reminds me — you went to see Amamiya, yes? Is she doing any better than she has been the last few times you’ve seen her?
lines.zh: : 这倒提醒了我——你去见 Amamiya 了吧?她比起你前几次见她的时候,有好一些吗?

lines.en: : Do you want to sit down first? So we’re not just...letting the food get cold?
lines.zh: : 要不我们先坐下说?省得就……让菜这么凉着?

lines.en: scene osakopica10
: Are you that hungry? Or just excited for dessert, maybe?
lines.zh: : 你有那么饿吗?还是说,是在期待餐后甜点?

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’ll even make it to dessert at this rate...
lines.zh: : 照这个节奏,我不知道自己还能不能撑到甜点那一步……

lines.en: scene osakopica11
: Hmm...so she’s struggling with something, but can’t dictate exactly what. How very teenager of her.
lines.zh: : 嗯……所以她在为什么挣扎,又说不出具体是什么。真是很「青少年」的她。

lines.en: : She says it feels sort of like she lost something.
lines.zh: : 她说,那感觉就像是弄丢了什么东西。

lines.en: : Was it as awkward as you expected it to be? I know you were worried about going.
lines.zh: : 有你预想的那么尴尬吗?我知道你之前一直担心要去。

lines.en: scene osakopica12
: It wasn’t that bad. And it’s obviously not like I’m against giving advice to girls her age or anything. It’s just...I see her somewhat regularly and if it came off as weird, it might ruin things.
lines.zh: : 也没有那么尴尬。而且我显然不是反对给她那个年纪的女孩提建议什么的。只是……我隔三差五就会见到她,万一显得怪异,可能会把事情搞砸。

lines.en: : Ahh, I suppose that’s why you weren’t this remorseful about your talk with the Irish girl then. MacCormack.
lines.zh: : 啊哈,我猜这就是为什么你和那个爱尔兰女孩——MacCormack——谈话之后,可没有这么自责。

lines.en: : Maybe. Though, it’s not like I really had any time to be remorseful at all given what I came back to after that.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过,想想我那之后回家面对的东西,我根本没有什么时间去自责。

lines.en: scene osakopica13
: Oh...right. That was the same night as the incident.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。那和「那件事」是同一个晚上。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re doing better now. Just...never scare me like that again, okay? I’m not really sure how I’d function without you...
lines.zh: : 嘿,你现在好多了。只是……再也不要那样吓我了,好吗?我真不确定没有你,我要怎么运转下去……

lines.en: scene osakopica14
: Well, you’re doing better when it comes to that. So I’d say we’ve both made some pretty substantial improvements as of late, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 嗯,在那方面你好多了。所以要说我们俩最近都取得了相当长足的进步,应该不为过吧?

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d go that far. Witchcraft class and the MILF of the Month club aren’t exactly improvements as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 这我可不敢苟同。巫术课和「本月 MILF 俱乐部」,在我看来可算不上什么进步。

lines.en: : But you’re trying at least. And I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t proud of you, Osako.
lines.zh: : 但至少你在尝试。如果我说我不为你骄傲,那就是在撒谎,Osako。

lines.en: scene osakopica15
: Stop...Wait until something sticks to be proud of me. I’m still in the “trying” phase. For all we know, I come out of this completely the same as I’ve always been.
lines.zh: : 别……等哪样东西真的坚持下来了,再为我骄傲。我还处在「尝试」阶段。谁知道呢,说不定我到最后还是和以前一模一样。

lines.en: : That’s worse news for you than it is for me. I’ve no reason to mourn how the woman I fell in love with is still the woman I fell in love with.
lines.zh: : 这对你来说可比对我来说是更坏的消息。我可没有理由去哀悼,「我爱上的那个女人居然还是我爱上时的那个女人」。

lines.en: : Thank you, Wakana...not just for that, but...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Wakana……不只是为这个,还有……

lines.en: : But what, my kitten? You can say it.
lines.zh: : 还有什么呢,我的小猫?你可以说出来。

lines.en: scene osakopica16
: You’ve just been really supportive and...and when you were tunneled in on the whole Girl Who Cannot Breathe thing, I wasn’t patient enough and I got too clingy.
lines.zh: : 你一直都非常支持我,而且……而且当你一头扎进「无法呼吸的女孩」那件事里时,我不够耐心,变得太黏人了。

lines.en: : You were supportive too, Osako. Don’t blame yourself for agonizing over a temporary obsession of mine. You had no way of knowing when that would ever end. You were right to be scared.
lines.zh: : 你也同样支持着我,Osako。别因为为我的一时执念而饱受煎熬就责怪自己。你根本无从知道那会在何时结束。你害怕,是应当的。

lines.en: : But still. I could have been better and I wasn’t. So I will be better from now on. I promise.
lines.zh: : 即便如此。我本可以做得更好,而我没有。所以从今往后,我会做得更好。我保证。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that conflict with your current mission, though? How you need a bit more distance to become as happy with you as I am?
lines.zh: : 不过,那不会和你现在的任务冲突吗?你需要再多一点距离,才能变得像我对你一样,对自己满意。

lines.en: : I want to figure out how to do both. Because I also don’t want to be the type of person who forgets anniversaries and...isn’t here to help you move furniture around.
lines.zh: : 我想找出两全的办法。因为我也不想成为那种会忘记纪念日、而且……不在你身边帮你搬家具的人。

lines.en: : That latter part is mostly forgivable. I had the Tsukioka family servants handle all of that when they dropped the food and wine off.
lines.zh: : 后半部分倒是基本可以原谅。Tsukioka 家的仆人送餐和酒过来时,把那些全都办妥了。

lines.en: scene osakopica17
: Fair enough...but in the future, it’ll be me. Okay? I can put my aspirations or...lack thereof on hold if it means being there for you.
lines.zh: : 说得也是……但以后,会是我来。好吗?如果这意味着能陪在你身边,我可以把我的抱负、或者……抱负的缺席先搁一搁。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, don’t force yourself, my love. What’s most important to me is that you’re happy. For I would be the one to truly struggle without you.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,别勉强自己,我的爱人。对我来说最重要的,是你幸福。因为真正离不开你的那个人,是我。

lines.en: scene osakopica18
: Yeah, sure you would. Like I’m going to believe that.
lines.zh: : 是嘛,你当然会。我才不信呢。

lines.en: : No, it’s true. The Tsukioka family won’t always be there to move furniture around for me. And it’s not like I can ask Akira for help when all he would do is come over and cry.
lines.zh: : 不,是真的。Tsukioka 家不会永远在那儿帮我搬家具。而我也没法找 Akira 帮忙——他能做的,只有过来哭一场。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, at least. Wait until I tell you what happened at the bar the other night.
lines.zh: : 这一点你说得倒没错。等我跟你说说前几天晚上酒吧里发生的事吧。

lines.en: : If it’s about him having sex with Rika, you can rest easy knowing that she sent me several drunk texts shortly after it happened.
lines.zh: : 如果是说他和 Rika 做爱的事,那你可以放心——事情发生后没多久,她就给我发来了好几条醉后短信。

lines.en: scene osakopica19
: Okay. So you got those too. I didn’t know.
lines.zh: : 好吧。原来你也收到了那些。我不知道。

lines.en: : Our mutual gossip has dropped well below the levels we’re accustomed to, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我们两人的共享八卦,已经远低于惯常水准了,Osako。

lines.en: : I’ve yet to even tell you about my exchange with Arakawa Jr. and how she had the audacity to imply that I’d be a good mother.
lines.zh: : 我甚至还没跟你说我和 Arakawa Jr. 的那次交谈呢——她竟敢暗示我会是个好妈妈。

lines.en: scene osakopica20
: Oh...yeah, I didn’t know about that.
lines.zh: : 哦……对,这事我不知道。

lines.en: scene osakopica21
: I don’t really know anything about that girl, though. Apart from the whole poetry thing and her mom being an abusive bitch, at least. But that’s not really fancy dinner talk.
lines.zh: : 不过,那个女孩的事我确实一无所知。至少,除了她写诗这一点,和她妈妈是个虐待狂贱人之外。但这可算不上什么高级晚宴话题。

lines.en: : No...it’s not, is it?
lines.zh: : 确实……算不上,是吧?

lines.en: : I agree that we should get our gossip levels back up, though. There’s like a million things I want to rant about that I just can’t because they all involve the people I would tell them to.
lines.zh: : 不过我同意,我们该把八卦水平提回来了。我有大概一百万件事想大吐苦水,却一件都说不了——因为它们全都和我会倾诉的那些人有关。

lines.en: scene osakopica22
: It’s like an annoying gossip paradox. I think I just need more friends. Maybe that’s the goal to figuring myself out? Stop surrounding myself with such weird people all the time.
lines.zh: : 简直是个恼人的八卦悖论。我觉得我只是需要更多的朋友。说不定这就是想明白自我的目标?别总让自己被这么一群怪人围着。

lines.en: : The way it is now, it’s like my existence is just intrinsically tied to all of you guys.
lines.zh: : 照现在这样,我的存在就像天生和你们所有人绑在一起。

lines.en: : And while that’s obviously true about my relationship with you on a much greater level, it still leaves a lot of...individuality to be desired, you know?
lines.zh: : 虽然就我和你的关系而言,在更深的层面上这显然是真的,但它还是让我的……个体性欠缺点什么,你懂吗?

lines.en: scene osakopica23
: Babe? Are-
lines.zh: : 宝贝?你是不是——

lines.en: scene osakopica24
: Huh?
scene osakopica25
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: scene black
scene osakopica26
: Osako Osaka.
lines.zh: : Osako Osaka。

lines.en: : Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God. What are you doing? Wakana, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 我的天,我的天,我的天。你在干什么?Wakana,你在干什么?

lines.en: : As you may know, I can’t properly kneel. So I would like you to pretend that I am doing so right now.
lines.zh: : 你可能知道,我没办法正经地跪下。所以,请你假装我此刻正跪着。

lines.en: : Oh my God...Wakana...Oh my fucking God...
lines.zh: : 我的天……Wakana……我他妈的天……

lines.en: : I don’t love you as if you were a rose of salt, topaz, or arrow of carnations that propagate fire. I love you as one loves certain obscure things, secretly, between the shadow and the soul.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,不是像爱盐渍的玫瑰、黄玉,或迸射火光的康乃馨之箭那样。我爱你,像爱某些幽晦的事物,秘密地,在阴影与灵魂之间。

lines.en: : Wakana...
lines.zh: : Wakana……

lines.en: : I love you as the plant that doesn’t bloom but carries the light of those flowers, hidden, within itself, and thanks to your love the tight aroma that arose from the earth lives dimly in my body.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,像爱那不开花、却在自身内部暗藏花朵光亮的植物;多亏你的爱,那从大地升起的浓郁香气,才幽微地活在我体内。

lines.en: : I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where. I love you directly without problems or pride.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,不知怎样爱,不知何时爱,也不知从何爱起。我爱你直接而单纯,没有问题,也没有骄傲。

lines.en: : I love you...oh my God...
lines.zh: : 我爱你……我的天……

lines.en: : I love you like this because I don’t know any other way to love, except in this form in which I am not nor are you, so close that your hand upon my chest is mine...
lines.zh: : 我这样爱你,因为此外我不知道还有什么爱的方式;爱到这个地步——我不存在,你也不存在,近得你搭在我胸上的手,就是我的手……

lines.en: : So close that your eyes close with my dreams.
lines.zh: : 近得你的眼睛,随我的梦一同闭上。

lines.en: : Oh my God...
lines.zh: : 我的天……

lines.en: : Osako Osaka...you are my best friend. My beloved partner. My everything and more. And there is nothing on this earth that would bring me more joy than becoming the nightshade that both cures you and kills you.
lines.zh: : Osako Osaka……你是我最好的朋友。我心爱的伴侣。我的一切,以及更多。这世上没有什么比成为那既治好你、又杀死你的龙葵,更能让我欢喜。

lines.en: : No matter who you become and what you resemble when you emerge from this cocoon, my love for you will not fade. It is impossible for you to not be beautiful to me.
lines.zh: : 无论你破茧而出时会变成谁、像什么,我对你的爱都不会褪色。对我来说,你不可能不美。

lines.en: : Wakana...
lines.zh: : Wakana……

lines.en: : I humbly ask you to spite the Japanese legal system with me and become my bride.
lines.zh: : 我谦卑地请求你,和我一起蔑视日本的法律体系,成为我的新娘。

lines.en: : Oh my God...
lines.zh: : 我的天……

lines.en: : Osako, will you marry me?
lines.zh: : Osako,你愿意嫁给我吗?
